description: This file defines the RoutingTraceService class responsible for managing routing trace steps, processing pending traces, extracting assignment reasons, and building reason strings within a routing trace context. It interacts with repositories and constants related to routing traces and assignment reasons.

classes.name: RoutingTraceService
classes.description: Service class for managing routing trace steps, processing traces for bookings, and extracting assignment reasons.

methods.name: getCurrent
methods.description: Retrieves the current RoutingTraceService instance from AsyncLocalStorage, if within a trace context.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a function within the context of this RoutingTraceService instance.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous function within the context of this RoutingTraceService instance.

methods.name: getStepsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of routing steps recorded.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a routing step with domain, step name, timestamp, and optional data.

methods.name: savePendingRoutingTrace
methods.description: Saves the current routing trace steps as a pending trace associated with a form response or queued form response.

methods.name: processForBooking
methods.description: Processes a pending routing trace for a booking, extracts assignment reason, creates a permanent trace, and returns the result.

methods.name: extractAssignmentReasonFromTrace
methods.description: Extracts the assignment reason from trace steps, prioritizing CRM (Salesforce) assignment over routing form.

methods.name: buildRoutingFormReasonString
methods.description: Builds a reason string for routing form routing, including rerouting info and attribute details.

methods.name: buildSalesforceReasonString
methods.description: Builds a reason string for Salesforce assignment, including account lookup or owner details.
